attributes.probed_form: PROBE A (joint, NEGATIVE, real 35 -> 46, insns T98/O102, ours-only -1 addi -3 lwz): deleted BOTH `s32 zero;` and `u32 word;`, respelling `zero` as the literal 0 at five sites and `word` as `header[0]` at four. The three extra lwz are `header[0]` reloaded: MWCC will not CSE the load across the intervening stores to `sample->`, so `word` is load-bearing. REVERTED the `word` half only. PROBE B (KEPT): `s32 zero;` deleted, its five uses respelled as the literal 0 (`sample->predScale = 0`, `sample->sampleRate = 0`, `sample->length = 0`, `sample->swappedLength = 0`, and the dropped `zero = 0;` initialiser). Frame 152 -> 144 = target, slot map SLOTS DIFFER (4T/4O) -> SLOT MAP IDENTICAL, real 35 -> 25, fresh fuzzy 96.4694 -> 96.5204. PROBE C (NEGATIVE, real 25 -> 35, reverted): reused the surviving `word` as the address carrier - `word = (u32)&sample->swappedLength; sample->length = word; *(u32*)word = DCS_SWAP32(header[3]);`. Still 99 insns AND it added register churn in the entry block. PROBE D (NEUTRAL-REARRANGED, reverted): removed the cast on the assigned value entirely - `*(*(u32**)&sample->length = &sample->swappedLength) = DCS_SWAP32(header[3]);`. `--ops` output was CHARACTER-IDENTICAL to probe B's, which refutes the cast-transit-no-CSE reading of this cluster: with no cast between the two roles MWCC still emits the address twice. PROBE E (real 25 -> 21 but FUZZY-REGRESSED 96.5204 -> 94.8980, rejected by the fuzzy gate and reverted): a declared pointer local - `u32* swapped = &sample->swappedLength; sample->length = (u32)swapped; *swapped = DCS_SWAP32(header[3]);` - which also did NOT remove the second addi.
attributes.residual: 25 real lines, ONE named mechanism: the pGAV branch computes `&sample->swappedLength` into TWO registers (`addi r4,r30,4` for the value stored to sample->length at 36(r30), `addi r0,r30,4` for the stwbrx index) where the target uses r3 for both, and the 48000 divisor's `lis`/`addi` pair sits AFTER the store block instead of before it. Three source shapes were measured against the duplication (word-reuse, pointer-view chained assignment, declared pointer local); none removed the second addi, and the pointer-view probe proves the cast is not the cause. Everything else in the function is byte-aligned: 8 further same-opcode rows differ only in a normalized branch target downstream of this one cluster.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: `fnasm game/audio/dcs VagParseHeader 0x60:0x84 --diff` after any edit that changes the divisor's position: if the two `addi rX,r30,4` rows survive with the divisor hoisted, the order theory is dead and the residual is a genuine two-role address duplication.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: yes - the aligned view at 0x60:0x84 shows target `lis r3,1` at 0x64 (before the block) and its `addi r0,r3,-17536` at 0x6c, with ONE `addi r3,r30,4` at 0x70 serving both `stw r3,36(r30)` and `stwbrx r4,0,r3`; ours emits `lis r3,1` at 0x74 (inside the block) and two addis at 0x68/0x6c. Not yet screened: whether any legal C form moves MWCC's constant materialisation.
hypothesis.statement: The surviving +1 addi is not a CSE failure but a materialisation-ORDER effect: the target hoists the 48000 divisor (`lis r3,1; addi r0,r3,-17536`) to the TOP of the pGAV block, which frees r3 to carry `&sample->swappedLength` for BOTH the `stw` value and the `stwbrx` index; ours materialises the divisor last and therefore needs two registers (r4 and r0) for the one address. A source form that makes the divisor's materialisation precede the store block - not a different spelling of the store - is the untried class.
